evidence_sentence: The Fall Fest Make It Take It on October 17 teaches Obvara Raku, a centuries-old technique creating organic surfaces on hot bisque-fired pots.
evidence_quote: Get ready to play with fire, fermentation, and a little bit of magic! summary: A hands-on two-hour Make It Take It session on October 17 exploring Obvara Raku, an Eastern European firing technique. Pottery provided; wear closed-toe shoes and long sleeves due to fire proximity. Work picked up two weeks after class.
